event_name: Document 37 Date 07 October 2018 Time 16:07 2018 JAPANESE GRAND PRIX 04 - 07 October 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 14 left the track at turn 16 and gained an advantage.
incident_time: Penalty (1 penalty points awarded, 3 points for the 12 month period)
offence: Breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence, and determined that although car 14 was forced off the track, car 14 thereafter cut the chicane and rejoined the track thereby gaining a significant advantage.
rules_referenced: Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 37 2018 Japanese Grand Prix Offence Car 14 Incident In Turn 16
